sentences.en: This planet's orbit is congested with hundreds of captured moons.
sentences.zh: 这个行星的轨道上被数百颗被捕获的卫星挤满了。

sentences.en: Of course, all the motorways were congested on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 当然，周日所有的高速公路都塞车了。

sentences.en: The expressway was congested with thousands of cars.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上塞满了成千上万辆汽车。

senses.zh: 挤满；超负荷（congest 的过去分词）

mnemonic: 词根记忆：congest（使充满，使拥塞）+ ed（…的）→充塞的
